content: When an intermittent CFFI/native teardown crash appears after successful assertions, do not retain mutable document-scoped native objects process-wide without proving isolation and bounded memory. Compare clean interpreter/native matrices first and use an explicit compatibility bound when the safe candidate is stable.
context: ISS-001/T-012: PLAN_REVIEW rejected a shared WeasyPrint FontConfiguration because @font-face mutates it and rejected a per-style lifetime cache because native memory would grow without bound. Python 3.13.13 passed 10 full-suite and 20 theme-suite fresh processes on the same WeasyPrint 68.1/Pango 1.58 stack where Python 3.14.6 had intermittent abnormal exits.
title: Prefer compatibility bounds over unsafe native lifetime caches
